title: Amazon Operations and Team Manager  SOPs | KPIs | 3+ Years)
description:
Who We Are

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across US, CA, UK, EU, AU, JP and expanding into Saudi Arabia. We operate across two brands: one in travel accessories and one in beauty devices, with 52+ active SKUs. We're at a turning point: moving from a founder-run business to a properly managed, systems-run company. This role is central to that transition.



The Role

This is not a VA role. This is an operations and team management position for someone who has done this before in an ecommerce or Amazon environment.

You will report directly to the two Founders and manage a team of 8-9 people across our Creative and Operations teams. You'll take our existing processes - currently scattered and undocumented --and build a proper system in ClickUp from scratch. You'll create SOPs, track KPIs, run tea
etings, and make sure everyone knows what they're doing and when.

Your mission is to build the systems, rhythm, and accountability that let the company run smoothly, without the founders being involved in every daily decision.

If you need someone to tell you what to do every day, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive with clear objectives and the autonomy to build real systems, keep reading.



What You'll Do:

- Set up ClickUp from scratch across all departments: workflows, dashboards, automations, task structures

- Make sure all work is captured in the system - nothing managed informally or lost in chat

- Coordinate between Creative and Operations teams so projects move smoothly

- Document existing business processes into clear, usable SOPs

- Handle day-to-day approvals within defined boundaries, escalating only real issues to the founders

- Lead weekly/monthly KPI reviews and quarterly planning sessions

- Run the weekly tea
eting - status updates, blockers, decisions - focused and on time

- Translate founders' quarterly objectives into clear team and individual goals

- Monitor performance, spot problems early, and drive corrective action

- Build and manage the product-launch workflow based on the existing 15-step launch process

- Spot what's slowing the team down and fix it - don't just flag it

- Keep an eye on profitability alongside the founders

- Onboard new hires: set up tools, assign SOPs, guide their first weeks



Tools You Must Know:

- ClickUp - expert level, you've built systems from scratch before

- Google Sheets / Excel - KPI dashboards, reporting

- Slack or similar - team communication

- Amazon Seller Central - you don't need to be a specialist, but you need to understand the context

- Zoom - weekly meetings with owner and team



Who We're Looking For:

We're looking for someone who's been in the trenches of ecommerce operations - not someone who's managed tasks, but someone who's built systems and led people.



- 3+ years in operations or team management in an ecommerce or Amazon environment

- You've built SOPs from scratch and know how to make processes that people actually follow

- You've set up ClickUp or similar tools for a team starting from zero

- You know how to keep a remote team aligned and accountable - without being on their back every hour

- You're comfortable with numbers - KPIs, margins, performance tracking

- Excellent English, written and verbal

- Familiarity with Amazon tools

- You're looking for somewhere to grow long-term, not just another contract



Compensation & Setup:

- $1,800–$2000+/month based on experience

- Full-time, 40h/week

- 14 days paid leave after 3 months

- First 3 months: time-tracked via Time Doctor as part of our standard onboarding process

- Long-term position - We Invest in People Who Invest in Us



What Success Looks Like

- Within 1 month: ClickUp is fully adopted, the weekly rhythm is running, and the founders' approval load has dropped significantly

- Within 3 months: KPIs are tracked and reviewed consistently; the team works to clear quarterly goals

- Within 6 months: the company runs smoothly day-to-day without the founders being involved in every decision





To Apply - Required

Answer these 4 questions:



1. Describe a project management system you built from scratch (ClickUp, Asana, Monday, or similar) - what was the situation, how did you structure it, and what changed after? Only apply if you have actually done this. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you did.

2. How do you hold a remote team accountable without micromanaging? Give a real example from one of the companies listed in your CV: include the team size, what tool you used, and what happened when someone missed a deadline. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you actually did.

3. Walk me through a company from your CV where you managed people — how many reported directly to you, what were their roles, and what did your one-on-ones or check-ins with them actually look like? What's one decision about a tea
mber (raise, warning, letting someone go, promotion) that was yours to make?

4. What project management tools have you used, and rate your confidence in each from 1 to 10. For the tool you rated highest - what's one thing you can do in it that most people don't know about?

title: Disputer - EXPEDITED Credit Repair
description:
We help business owners fix their credit and then get approved for $50K to $150K+ in funding. Credit repair is the front door. A lot of people come to us close but not quite fundable, and your job is to get them there: cleaner reports, higher scores, the right profile, ready to fund.



We're looking for a Credit Repair Specialist to own that whole journey. You'll take someone with real problems on their report and walk them out the other side funding-ready. Right now this work lives in the founder's head, and we need you to run it better than he could.



This is not a mill where you fire off template disputes and hope. You'll manage a real book of clients and actually move their numbers, the right way.



HOW THIS WORKS



This is a part-time role, and that's on purpose. Credit repair here isn't a 40-hour seat with busywork to fill the day. You manage a book of clients on your own schedule. A book of 10 to 20 clients runs about 10 to 15 hours a week for someone who knows what they're doing.



You get paid when a client reaches funding-ready, and again when that client funds. Slow month means less work and less pay. Busy month means more of both. If you're the type who wants to run a solid book without a boss watching the clock, this setup is built for you. We'll go over the exact numbers on the call.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



Pull and read full reports across all three bureaus and figure out exactly what's holding the score back.



Build a repair plan: which items to dispute, what to pay down, what to add, and a realistic timeline to funding-ready.



Run the dispute process end to end. File it, track the bureau responses, re-dispute where it makes sense, handle validation. Follow it through the full cycle instead of firing and forgetting.



Coach clients on the behavior that actually moves a score. Utilization, on-time payments, and not opening the wrong accounts at the wrong time.



Track score movement and keep clients motivated through a process that takes months, not days.



Get clients to funding-ready with a 700+ score and a clean profile, then hand them clean to the funding side.



Keep the CRM current. If it's not in the CRM, it didn't happen.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Read this first: this role is for experienced credit repair specialists only. Not for beginners. If you're new to credit or you're hoping to learn on the job, this isn't it, and we'll know within one question on the interview call.



You've read full credit reports before and you know what drags a score down and how to bring it back up. This one is non-negotiable.



You know the dispute process and the rules around it. You work clean and compliant, and you never promise a client something you can't legally deliver.



Familiar with CFPB, BBB, FTC, FCRA, and FDCPA.



You're the kind of organized where nothing slips. You can carry 25 to 30+ clients at once and keep every one moving.



Your written and spoken English is clean and professional. Clients trust you inside the first five minutes.



You actually like working with clients. You follow up before they have to chase you.



You're independent. Give you a goal and a playbook and you run with it. You don't need someone standing over your shoulder telling you what to do next.



NICE TO HAVE



Experience in funding as well as credit repair, so you understand where the client is headed after you.



Time spent in a CRM like GoHighLevel, Notion, Clickup, or something similar.



You've helped build or tighten up SOPs, not just followed them.



WHAT YOU GET



A real book of clients who want to be here, not a spammy cold list.



Playbooks and templates so you're not guessing. Where they don't exist yet, you'll help build them.



Direct access to the founder. No layers, no politics.



Room to grow into running the whole credit side as we scale.



HOW WE'LL MEASURE YOU



You'll know exactly what winning looks like. Once you're ramped, here's what we expect:



Plans out fast. Every client has a repair plan within 3 business days of onboarding.



Scores that move. Clients see real, steady score improvement, and a strong share reach funding-ready inside 60 to 90 days.



Disputes that don't stall. Every dispute cycle tracked and actioned on time. Nothing sits waiting on you.



Follow-through. 85%+ of your clients do their part (paydowns, docs, action steps) on schedule, because you're staying on them.



Nobody goes dark. Every active client hears from you at least once a week with a real update, not a "just checking in."



Clean handoffs. When a client hits funding-ready, they move to the funding side with a full, accurate file. No gaps.



CRM stays current. Statuses and notes updated the same day, every day. No end-of-week catch-up.



HOW TO APPLY



Send us:



Your resume



2 to 3 sentences on your credit repair experience. Be specific about what you've actually done, not what you've read about.



One example of a client whose credit you meaningfully improved, and how you did it.



Use the subject line: "Clean Slate"



Applications without that subject line or without real credit experience won't get read. We work in the details here, so show us yours.

title: Social Media Manager (Part-Time)
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY: 



Noserider Surf Club makes surf suits that stay on. Handmade in Bali, sold worldwide via 
, a retail shop in Canggu, and a growing roster of wholesale partners. Functionality and sustainability go hand in hand. Our customers care about both, and so do we.



We're small, fast, and protective of the brand. Social is where a lot of new customers meet us for the first time, and we're at the point where it needs a dedicated owner so the founder can keep building.





ABOUT THE FOUNDER: 



Emma founded Noserider after moving to Bali to surf and finding nothing on the market that was both supportive in the water and something she actually wanted to wear. She sketched the first surf set herself, worked with a local tailor to make it, and built the brand from there. 



She still runs Noserider day to day from Bali, hands-on with the factories, and owns product and creative direction. She's the person you'd be working with most closely in this role. 



More on Emma's story here: 
 





ABOUT THE ROLE: 



We're hiring a part-time Social Media Manager to own the day-to-day of Noserider's Instagram and TikTok. We already have a deep library of content: product photos, video, and behind-the-scenes footage from Bali. This role turns that raw material into a consistent, on-brand presence and a steady flow of fresh ad creative.



The work is fast and hands-on. You watch what's trending on TikTok and Reels, spot the formats that fit Noserider, and cut our footage into them. You keep a steady pipeline of ad creative going out, testing different hooks and edits so there's always something fresh to run. You also own the posting calendar and keep it consistent. This is daily editing and posting, not the occasional hero video.



Emma still creates the founder-voice and story-driven pieces herself, and creative direction stays with her. This isn't a strategy or art-direction seat. It's for someone genuinely fast and good at turning raw footage into short-form video that performs.





WHO THRIVES HERE: 



The person who thrives here lives on TikTok and Reels and genuinely enjoys it. You hear a trending audio or spot a format and immediately see how Noserider's footage could fit it. You're fast in the edit, you have taste, and you care about the small details that make a post feel native to the platform instead of like an ad.



You're also organized. You take a library of raw clips and turn it into a planned, consistent posting schedule without being chased. You keep the calendar full and the ad creative flowing, so Emma can stay focused on product, brand, and the work only she can do.





RESPONSIBILITIES: 



- Sort, edit, and publish content from our existing library into consistent, on-brand posts for Instagram and TikTok

- Edit short-form video (CapCut or similar): hooks, captions, trending audio, clean cuts

- Watch trends and reformat our footage into the formats that are working right now

- Produce a steady stream of ad creatives, giving us multiple variations to test so we always have fresh creative to run

- Schedule and publish posts (we use Later)

- Write captions that sound like the brand (you can lean on AI to draft, but the voice has to land)

- Keep our content organized so nothing good gets lost in the library





REQUIREMENTS::



- Strong hands-on short-form video editing (CapCut or similar) for Instagram and TikTok

- A portfolio or examples of Reels/TikToks you've edited

- Real experience producing ad creatives and testing variations

- Experience with trend research and finding creative ways to fit a brand into what's trending

- A strong design eye: you make polished, on-brand graphics in Canva, not just basic templates

- Good written English for captions

- Based in the Philippines, available part-time (around 20 hrs/week), with some working-hour overlap with Bali (UTC+8)

- Reliable internet and your own editing setup



Bonus points if you have:



- Experience using AI tools for video editing (auto-captions, AI cuts, generative b-roll, etc.)

- Experience running or supporting an active Instagram or TikTok for an apparel, fashion, or lifestyle brand

- Surfing, surf culture interest, or any lived experience that helps you feel the brand

- Experience with Later or a similar scheduling tool





WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU? 



- $600 USD/month, part-time (around 20 hrs/week), with the possibility of becoming full-time

- Paid monthly

- The first 30 days is a paid probation period to make sure the fit is right for both parties; we'll reassess together at the 30-day mark

- Fully remote, with some overlap with Bali (UTC+8)

- A long-term role inside a small team building a real brand

- Direct working relationship with the founder





HOW TO APPLY?



Apply via our application form:: 
 

We read every application.

title: Online Math/Science Teacher(Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.



Qualifications



Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: Experienced Virtual Bookkeeping Assistant
description:
About the role



I am looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant with bookkeeping experience to support my small business based in Finland.



My work is rooted in creativity, education, personal growth, intercultural collaboration, online courses, events, retreats, artistic projects, and positive transformation. Because the business includes several different types of income and international activities, I am looking for someone who enjoys bringing clarity, structure, and simplicity to financial administration.



This role would suit someone who already has some practical bookkeeping experience and is interested in helping create a clear, low-maintenance financial system that can grow with the business.



You are welcome to visit www.enchantedboa.love to get a sense of the work, values, and energy behind the business. There is no need to be personally involved in the spiritual or healing fields, but respect, openness, and comfort working with a purpose-driven and unconventional business are important.



Your responsibilities may include

• Organizing and categorizing receipts, invoices, expenses, and payments

• Preparing bookkeeping information for review and reporting

• Reconciling bank, PayPal, Kajabi, and other payment transactions

• Supporting VAT tracking and reporting

• Helping prepare information related to Finnish and EU tax requirements

• Supporting EU VAT OSS reporting

• Organizing receipts and documents in English, Finnish, and Portuguese

• Following up on missing receipts or unclear transactions

• Maintaining clear digital folders and bookkeeping records

• Helping improve and simplify existing financial processes

• Communicating with me and, when necessary, coordinating with an accountant

• Creating checklists, routines, and systems that require as little ongoing maintenance as possible



Experience and skills

You should have:

• Previous bookkeeping or accounting-related experience

• Good attention to detail and a high level of accuracy

• Confidence working with spreadsheets and financial records

• Strong organizational and problem-solving skills

• Clear written and spoken English

• The ability to work independently and ask questions when something is unclear

• Respect for confidentiality and sensitive financial information

• A willingness to learn about Finnish bookkeeping, VAT, and tax-reporting requirements



Experience with any of the following is a strong advantage:

• Zoho Books

• EU VAT OSS reporting

• Finnish or European bookkeeping

• International or multi-currency businesses

• PayPal, Kajabi, Stripe, or similar payment platforms

• Digital products, online courses, events, retreats, or service-based businesses

• Working with multilingual receipts or documents



You do not need to speak Finnish or Portuguese fluently, but you should feel comfortable working with receipts and documents in these languages and using translation tools when needed.



The kind of person I am looking for



I would love to work with someone who is:

• Honest, dependable, and consistent

• Warm and professional in communication

• Naturally organized and detail-oriented

• Comfortable supporting a creative and somewhat unconventional business

• Interested in finding practical and creative solutions

• Able to work flexibly as the needs of the business develop

• Proactive without making assumptions

• Willing to learn and grow together with the role



I value transparency, kindness, clear communication, and mutual respect. I am looking for a long-term working relationship with someone who genuinely enjoys helping a small business become more financially organized and sustainable.



Hours and working arrangement

This will initially be a part-time, flexible role. The number of hours may vary depending on the bookkeeping cycle and current projects.



Please include your preferred hourly rate and your general weekly availability in your application.



How to apply

In your application, please answer the following questions:

1. What bookkeeping experience do you already have?

2. Which bookkeeping or accounting software have you used?

3. Do you have experience with Zoho Books?

4. Do you have any experience with VAT, EU VAT OSS, or European businesses?

5. Have you worked with PayPal, Kajabi, Stripe, or other online payment systems?

6. How would you approach organizing receipts written in English, Finnish, and Portuguese?

7. Please describe one bookkeeping or administrative system you have helped simplify or improve.

8. What is your hourly rate and current availability?

9. Why does this particular role interest you?

Please also include a brief example of how you would handle a transaction or receipt that you were unsure how to categorize.

I look forward to hearing from applicants who appreciate both financial clarity and meaningful, purpose-driven work.

About Us



We are a Canadian company building Amazon FBA private label and wholesale operations in the United States and Canada. We are looking for an Amazon private label creative designer who can support product launches with strong Amazon listing images, A+ Content, packaging visuals, product inserts, mockups, videos, and other launch-related creatives.



This is not a general graphic design role. We need someone with direct Amazon private label creative experience.





Experience Level Required



We are looking for an intermediate to senior-level creative designer with 2+ years of direct Amazon private label creative design experience.



Candidates should already understand Amazon listing image structure, product infographics, A+ Content, comparison charts, feature/benefit visuals, product image editing, packaging visuals, and conversion-focused Amazon product presentation.

You will help create end-to-end creative assets for Amazon FBA private label product launches. The work may include listing image sets, product infographics, A+ Content, product mockups, packaging visuals, inserts, short product videos, ad creatives, and other Amazon launch-related assets.



The main goal is to make physical products look clear, premium, trustworthy, and conversion-focused on Amazon.





Key Responsibilities



• Design complete Amazon listing image sets, including main image concepts, secondary images, benefit images, product-in-use visuals, bundle visuals, and comparison graphics.

• Create product infographics showing features, dimensions, materials, benefits, use cases, bundle contents, and customer pain-point solutions.

• Design A+ Content / Enhanced Brand Content, brand story visuals, comparison modules, and product education graphics.

• Create packaging concepts, box mockups, labels, inserts, thank-you cards, instruction cards, and other printed assets.

• Create or edit short product videos, product demo videos, listing videos, ad-style videos, and launch creatives when needed.

• Keep creative files, source files, exports, versions, and references organized in Google Drive.

• Communicate clearly about completed work, design notes, missing assets, blockers, revisions, and next steps.





Requirements



• 2+ years of direct Amazon creative design experience required, including Amazon listing images, product infographics, A+ Content, product image editing, comparison charts, packaging visuals, inserts, product mockups, and/or Amazon product videos.

• Intermediate to senior-level design ability required.

• Strong portfolio required.

• Strong static design ability required.

• Experience with tools such as Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, Figma, CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects, AI image/video tools, or similar tools.

• Strong attention to detail with spelling, product claims, dimensions, packaging text, image sizes, file formats, and revisions.

• Organized, reliable, responsive, and comfortable working independently.





Not Suitable For



This role is not suitable for candidates whose experience is mainly general VA work, customer service, basic Canva templates, logo-only design, or social-media-only graphics. We are looking for someone with Amazon private label product creative ability.





How to Apply



To apply, start your message with:



“Amazon Creative Designer”



Then include:



1. Your portfolio link

2. Your direct Amazon creative experience

3. Your experience with listing images, infographics, A+ Content, packaging, inserts, mockups, and video

title: Senior Video Editor (Long-Form VSLs & Meta Ads)
description:
Senior Video Editor (Long-Form VSLs & Meta Ads) – Full-Time



We’re a fast-growing e-commerce brand focused on building high-converting video ads for Meta.



[Briefly explain your company and product here.]



Example:



* What product(s) do you sell?

* Who is your target audience?

* What makes your product unique?

* Why does your product work differently from competitors?

* What problem does it solve?



?



What we’re really after (please read this carefully)



This is the most important part of the role, so we’ll be direct about it.



Our biggest growth opportunity sits at the very top of the funnel — with cold, “unaware” and “problem-aware” audiences.



These are people who experience the problem every day but don’t yet understand the real cause behind it. They often haven’t connected the dots yet and may not even know a solution exists.



That means our ads shouldn’t immediately mention diagnoses, product categories, or obvious solutions. Instead, our best-performing ads:



* Lead with a relatable symptom, frustration, or everyday situation.

* Reframe the problem by revealing a hidden cause the viewer never considered.

* Naturally bridge into the solution, proof, and offer.



We’re specifically looking for an editor who can build long-form, top-of-funnel storytelling ads that educate and reframe—not just conversion edits for warm audiences.



Our videos are getting longer, not shorter. The ability to keep a cold viewer engaged for 2–4+ minutes is the single most valuable skill you can bring.



This is a senior role. We’re not looking for someone who’s still learning. We need someone who has already edited high-performing long-for
ta ads and can prove it.



?



What you’ll be doing



* Edit long-form VSL ads (2–4+ minutes) designed to move cold audiences from problem awareness to purchase.

* Build narrative arcs:

    * Hook

    * Problem

    * Reframe

    * Solution

    * Proof

    * CTA

* Edit with strong pacing for retention (cuts every 2–4 seconds, captions, motion graphics, B-roll layering).

* Work from structured creative briefs and customer avatars.

* Translate written scripts into emotionally engaging visual stories.



?



What this role is NOT



We’re not looking for someone who simply cuts clips together.



We’re looking for someone who understands:



* Why a 3-minute Meta ad keeps a cold audience watching.

* How to layer B-roll, text, music and AI visuals to build narrative tension.

* Which first five seconds matter most.

* How pacing and visual rhythm influence retention.

* How editing differs between unaware audiences and audiences ready to buy.



?



Requirements



* Senior-level experience editing long-form/VSL Meta ads.

* Proven experience with direct-response advertising.

* Please share examples.

* Strong AI image and AI video generation skills.

* Experience with Premiere Pro, After Effects or CapCut Pro.

* Understanding of performance marketing.

* Ability to transform scripts into engaging visual stories.

* Experience with captions, motion graphics, color grading and B-roll.

* Ability to source stock footage, UGC and brand assets.

* Fluent English.



Nice to have



* Experience editing for older demographics.

* Experience within health, wellness or similar consumer niches.



?



What we offer



* Full-time position (8 hours per day).

* Long-term opportunity.

* Clear systems, customer avatars, scripts and creative briefs.

* Room to grow with the company.

* Direct collaboration with the creative strategist.



?



How to apply



If you’ve read this carefully, start your application with the word “Editing”. Applications without it will be skipped.



Then send us:



1. Three (3) long-for
ta ads you’ve edited that target unaware or problem-aware audiences (minimum 2 minutes each).

2. At least three realistic AI-generated scenes you’ve created for storytelling in video ads.

3. A few sentences explaining why you’re the right fit for this role.

4. Review our product:

    [Insert your product page here.]

5. Based on our product, briefly describe one long-form VSL concept (2–3 minutes) you would create, including the narrative arc and visual storytelling approach for a cold audience.

6. Tell us which editing and AI tools you use, and your typical turnaround time per video.



Thank you.



Best regards,

title: Senior Creative Strategist Lead
description:
We are looking for a Senior Creative Strategist to join our eCommerce team and create high performing ad concepts, hooks, scripts, advertorials, landing page messaging, and creative briefs for our DTC brands.



This role is ideal for someone with strong direct-response experience who understands buyer psychology, performance marketing, Meta ads, and what makes creatives convert.



This is not a basic content writing role. We need someone who can research winning ads, find strong angles, write persuasive copy, and create ad concepts that are ready for production and testing.



Key Responsibilities



Your main responsibility will be to write strong direct-response ad concepts, hooks, scripts, advertorial copy, landing page messaging, and creative briefs that can help us test and scale winning creatives.



You will be responsible for turning product research, customer pain points, competitor swipes, and performance learnings into strong ad ideas.



What You’ll Do



* Research winning ads, competitors, customer pain points, and market trends

* Create strong ad angles, hooks, scripts, and UGC-style concepts

* Write high-converting ad copy, primary text, headlines, captions, and CTA variations

* Write advertorial copy, presell page copy, and landing page messaging

* Create clear creative briefs for video editors and UGC creators

* Build creative concepts based on direct-response principles and buyer psychology

* Analyze creative performance and suggest new iterations based on data

* Identify new hooks, emotional triggers, formats, and messaging opportunities

* Work closely with media buyers, video editors, and the creative team

* Make sure all ad concepts are clear, persuasive, and production-ready



What We’re Looking For



* 3+ years of experience as a Creative Strategist in DTC eCommerce, ideally with 6 to 7 figure brands

* Strong hands on copywriting ability across ads, scripts, advertorials, and landing pages

* Proven ability to write high-converting direct response copy

* Strong understanding of hooks, angles, buyer psychology, UGC ads, Meta ads, and performance marketing

* Ability to analyze winning ads and adapt the structure to new products

* Experience writing creative briefs for editors and UGC creators

* Strong understanding of what makes ad creatives convert on Meta

* Experience with supplements, health, wellness, beauty, or consumer products is a strong plus

* High standards, strong attention to detail, and fast execution



You Are a Great Fit If You:



* Can instantly identify strong and weak hooks

* Know how to turn customer pain points into strong ad angles

* Understand direct-response copywriting and performance creative strategy

* Can write scripts that feel native, persuasive, and conversion focused

* Are comfortable working with swipes, competitor ads, landing pages, and performance data

* Can create multiple strong creative concepts quickly

* Care about performance, testing, and improving results



This Role Is Not For You If:



* You only write basic captions or generic content

* You are focused only on brand storytelling and not performance marketing

* You give random ad ideas without strong reasoning

* You cannot explain why a hook, angle, or script should work

* You are not comfortable writing direct-response ads for paid traffic



You Should Be Confident Writing:



* Hooks

* Ad angles

* UGC scripts

* Primary text

* Headlines

* CTA variations

* Creative briefs

* Advertorial copy

* Presell page copy

* Landing page messaging

* Offer messaging

* Emotional and conversion-focused copy



Work Setup



* Full time remote role

* Long term opportunity

* Clear systems and SOPs provided

* You will work closely with our media buying, creative, editing, and strategy teams

* Availability overlap with our team will be required



Compensation



The base salary is $3,000/month. A commission structure is also included and will be discussed during the interview. Commission is tied to creative performance and output quality.



Hiring Process



1. Application review

2. Loom video review

3. Portfolio and past work review

4. Paid test task

5. Interview

6. Trial period

7. Final offer and onboarding



To Apply



Please complete the application form below. Applications submitted without the form will not be considered.

title: Amazon Private Label Product Research, Sourcing and Launch Specialist / Operations Lead
description:
Position: Amazon Private Label Product Research, Sourcing & Launch Specialist / Operations Lead



Type: Part-Time or Full-Time, Remote/Hybrid (Philippines)



Compensation: PHP 30,000 - 60,000 / month full-time equivalent, depending on level, experience, and proven Amazon Private Label capability. Specialist level: PHP 30,000 - 45,000 / month. Lead level: PHP 45,000 - 60,000 / month. Part-time compensation will be prorated based on agreed weekly hours.



Schedule: Full-time PH daytime hours or fixed part-time blocks, with flexibility for China supplier and Amazon-related communication.





About Our Company:



We are a Canadian corporation specialized in international trade and e-commerce. We operate in the global market and use ecommerce platforms such as Amazon to develop new brands and products for international customers. Our company values professionalism, data-driven decision-making, ownership, and long-term partnerships. We are building a strong, world-class team in the Philippines.





Role Overview:



We are hiring for this function across two levels: Amazon Private Label Specialist and Amazon Private Label Operations Lead. Both levels support our end-to-end Amazon private label operation, with the final level based on the candidate’s experience, judgment, ownership, and ability to work independently.



This is a hands-on Amazon Private Label role covering the full operation from product research and market analysis through supplier sourcing, product development, listing preparation, launch support, inventory and shipment coordination, Seller Central follow-up, post-launch monitoring, reporting, and ongoing process improvement.



Specialist-level candidates should be able to independently execute Amazon private label product research, supplier sourcing, competitor analysis, review analysis, listing support, launch preparation, and Amazon operations with strong accuracy, clear reporting, and good judgment. The specialist should be comfortable using SOPs and templates, but should not rely on step-by-step supervision for every task.



Lead-level candidates should be able to take ownership of Amazon private label opportunities end-to-end, including product research, sourcing direction, product improvement, supplier evaluation, launch planning, Amazon operations, and post-launch monitoring. The lead should be able to review work critically, guide execution quality, improve SOPs/templates, identify risks early, and make practical business recommendations with less supervision.



Candidates should have hands-on Amazon Private Label experience. General e-commerce, Shopify, dropshipping, social media, or basic Amazon VA experience is helpful only if it includes direct Amazon Private Label work.





Key Responsibilities:



•	Conduct or lead Amazon product research using Helium 10, Keepa, Amazon search, Amazon Seller Central data, and other available Amazon research tools.

•	Evaluate product opportunities using demand, pricing, competition, reviews, profitability, keyword opportunity, launch difficulty, differentiation potential, and operational risk.

•	Prepare clear product recommendations and explain the reasoning in a practical business-focused way.

•	Source and communicate with suppliers through Alibaba, 1688, Global Sources, and other sourcing platforms.

•	Request and compare supplier quotes, MOQ, lead time, sample cost, customization options, packaging options, compliance details, shipping details, and product improvement options.

•	Identify product improvement opportunities through review mining, competitor analysis, listing analysis, market gaps, customer complaints, and supplier capability checks.

•	Support product development by turning market findings, supplier options, and customer feedback into practical product specifications and improvement ideas.

•	Support or guide listing preparation, including keyword research, positioning, title and bullet inputs, image direction, A+ content inputs, competitor listing review, and product positioning.

•	Support launch preparation, including listing readiness, inventory planning, shipment coordination, sample follow-up, launch planning, missing-item follow-up, and blocker resolution.

•	Coordinate with designers, copywriters, PPC specialists, suppliers, prep centers, freight forwarders, or other contractors when needed.

•	Monitor Amazon Seller Central issues such as listing status, account health, suppressed listings, inventory status, customer feedback, returns, and operational risks.

•	Monitor post-launch performance, including sales, keyword movement, conversion signals, customer reviews, returns, stock level, pricing, PPC coordination, and competitor activity.

•	Prepare clear management updates with risks, blockers, recommended decisions, next actions, and execution priorities.

•	Keep Google Drive, Google Sheets, supplier records, product files, operation trackers, and Amazon operation documents organized and updated.

•	Flag weak assumptions, supplier risks, launch risks, listing risks, inventory risks, Amazon account concerns, or execution issues early.

•	For Lead-level candidates: review junior/support work, improve SOPs, templates, checklists, trackers, and help raise execution quality over time.





Qualifications:



•	Specialist level: 2-4+ years of direct Amazon Private Label experience preferred.

•	Lead level: 5-8+ years of direct Amazon Private Label experience preferred.

•	General Amazon FBA experience alone is not enough unless it includes hands-on Private Label work.

•	Experience with Amazon product research, supplier sourcing, product development, listing preparation, launch support, post-launch monitoring, and Amazon operations support.

•	Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central, Helium 10, Keepa, Alibaba, Google Sheets, Google Drive, and structured research templates.

•	Strong understanding of Amazon product research, keyword research, competitor analysis, review analysis, pricing, profitability, launch difficulty, and product differentiation.

•	Strong supplier communication and follow-up skills, especially with China-based suppliers.

•	Strong written English communication and clear reporting ability.

•	Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple product opportunities at different stages.

•	Comfortable following SOPs while also using judgment when a business decision requires practical thinking.

•	Comfortable using AI tools to improve research quality, analysis, judgment, workflow speed, and communication while verifying information carefully.

•	Able to work independently and provide clear updates, risks, decisions needed, and next steps.

•	Comfortable with both pre-launch and post-launch Amazon Private Label operations.





KPIs / Success Measures:



•	Quality and accuracy of Amazon product research, supplier sourcing, listing preparation, launch support, and operation files.

•	Quality of product opportunity judgment and ability to separate weak products from realistic launch candidates.

•	Accuracy of market data, competitor analysis, keyword research, review analysis, profitability assumptions, and launch planning inputs.

•	Quality of supplier outreach, quote comparison, product improvement requests, sample coordination, and supplier follow-up.

•	Ability to identify risks early before they affect product selection, supplier selection, launch timing, listing quality, inventory availability, or account performance.

•	Clear communication of blockers, risks, next steps, tradeoffs, and recommended decisions.

•	Low error rate in data entry, supplier details, Amazon listing details, cost assumptions, and research reports.

•	Reliable ownership across product research, sourcing, product development, launch preparation, Seller Central follow-up, and post-launch monitoring.

•	For Lead-level candidates: ability to improve execution quality, guide junior/support work, and improve SOPs, templates, or trackers when needed.

•	Consistent ability to follow company instructions, SOPs, policies, and communication standards while also applying sound judgment.





What We Offer:



•	Part-time or full-time remote work opportunity with a Canadian company.

•	Opportunity to work across the full Amazon private label process from product research to post-launch operations.

•	Long-term opportunity as the Amazon private label business grows.

•	Structured SOPs, templates, and process support.

•	Direct communication with company management.

•	Opportunity to grow into higher ownership based on proven capability and results.

•	Performance-based growth opportunities based on ownership, reliability, and execution quality.





Application Instructions:



To apply, please include the phrase "Amazon PL Role" in the first line of your application and answer the following questions briefly:

1.	Are you applying for Specialist level, Lead level, or open to either level based on assessment?

2.	Are you applying for full-time or part-time work? If part-time, how many hours per week can you consistently commit?

3.	How many years of direct Amazon Private Label experience do you have?

4.	Which Amazon tools have you used directly? Please mention Helium 10, Keepa, Seller Central, Alibaba, or others if applicable.

5.	Describe one private label product you helped identify, source, launch, improve, or scale. Please mention your exact role in the process.

6.	What makes a product a poor private label launch candidate, even if the sales look strong?

7.	Are you comfortable completing a practical Amazon PL assessment before final hiring?

title: Shopify Specialist – POS Rollouts, Store Setup & Data Migration
description:
We’re looking for a hands-on Shopify specialist to help us roll out Shopify POS for retail businesses.



The role combines Shopify store setup, data migration, troubleshooting and project coordination.



A major part of the work involves taking data from older POS systems, cleaning and restructuring it, and preparing it correctly for Shopify.



This is not a basic product upload role.



You should understand how products, variants, SKUs, barcodes, inventory and locations fit together, and be comfortable working with large Excel and CSV files.



Some projects may involve several thousand SKUs, so attention to detail and confidence working with data are important.



Main responsibilities:



• Set up and configure Shopify stores

• Help prepare and roll out Shopify POS

• Clean and restructure product data

• Prepare and validate Shopify import files

• Manage products, variants, inventory and locations

• Install and configure Shopify apps

• Troubleshoot Shopify and configuration issues

• Test store and POS workflows

• Keep tasks, notes and project timelines up to date

• Follow up on missing information and flag issues early



Shopify POS experience is useful but not essential.



We care more about strong Shopify knowledge, data skills, attention to detail and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems quickly.



A good visual eye is also valued. Experience building polished Shopify stores using existing Shopify themes would be a strong bonus.



We’re looking for someone who:



• Knows Shopify Admin well

• Is confident using Excel and CSV files

• Has experience with Shopify imports or data migration

• Can investigate problems and work towards a solution

• Is organised and able to keep work moving

• Can communicate clearly with clients and tea
mbers

• Is comfortable using AI tools and structured workflows

• Can work independently without constant supervision

• Has some overlap with Australian working hours



This is a direct role. We are not looking for an agency or someone who outsources the work.



The role will begin part-time, with the opportunity for more hours and ongoing work if it is a good fit.



To apply, please include:



• Your current availability

• Examples of Shopify stores you personally worked on

• What you personally handled on those projects

• The largest product catalogue or CSV file you have worked with

• Your experience with Excel, CSV files and Shopify imports

• An example of a Shopify or systems problem you investigated and resolved

• Any Shopify POS experience
salary: US$6–8 per hour, depending on experience

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Please apply here: 
 



At Skinnify (www.skinnify.co), we make clothing with built-in resistance — leggings, sleeves, shoes, and more — that turn everyday movements like walking, cooking, or commuting into a passive workout. In just three years, we've grown from 0 to 150,000+ customers – and we're just getting started.



To get a better idea of our company and what it's like to work on our team, check out this short video:





Now, we're looking for a full-time Personal Assistant (40 hours/week) to support our Executive Assistant, who works directly with our Founder & CEO. The CEO will assign priorities to the Executive Assistant, who will then delegate tasks to you. We're looking for someone who executes quickly, stays organized under pressure, and thrives in the fast-paced world of DTC e-commerce.



???? Your Responsibilities

? Support the Executive Assistant in managing the CEO's daily administrative and operational tasks

? Manage calendars, schedule meetings, coordinate appointments, and organize travel arrangements

? Call third-party companies, suppliers, service providers, government agencies, and business partners on behalf of the company

? Follow up with internal tea
mbers to ensure projects and recurring tasks are completed on time

? Conduct online research and prepare reports, comparisons, and summaries

? Assist with project management and coordinate tasks across multiple departments

? Organize documents, spreadsheets, and internal systems

? Handle various business and personal administrative requests delegated by the Executive Assistant

? Identify problems proactively and execute solutions with minimal supervision

? Continuously improve processes to help the team operate more efficiently



???? What We're Looking For

?? DTC E-commerce Experience – You've previously worked for an e-commerce brand and understand the speed and priorities of a fast-growing online business

?? Fast Executor – You move quickly, complete tasks without constant follow-ups, and know how to prioritize effectively

?? Highly Organized – You're excellent at managing multiple priorities simultaneously without missing deadlines

?? Excellent Communicator – Strong written and verbal English skills, with confidence speaking to third parties over
 and phone

?? Proactive Problem Solver – You anticipate issues before they arise and take initiative to resolve them

?? Trustworthy & Discreet – You'll regularly handle confidential company and executive information

?? Independent Yet Collaborative – You can work autonomously while coordinating effectively with the Executive Assistant and the rest of the team

?? Detail-Oriented – You catch the small details that others often overlook



???? Why Join Skinnify?

???? Join a Hyper-Growth Brand – From 0 to 150,000+ customers in just 3 years. Your work will directly support the leadership team behind one of Europe's fastest-growing DTC brands.

???? Real Career Growth – Your trajectory here is whatever you make of it. One tea
mber went from Video Editor to Creative Strategist and doubled their salary. Another started in Customer Support and now manages the entire Customer Support department. We promote from within and invest in people who want to grow.

???? Full Flexibility – Work from anywhere, anytime. We run on trust and results—not time tracking. As long as the work gets done, your hours are yours.

???? Learning Budget – Courses, books, consulting calls—we cover it. Many tea
mbers book calls with founders of major e-commerce brands and executives from leading companies through platforms like Intro and MentorPass.

?? Two Company Retreats a Year, Fully Paid – Twice a year, we rent a house in a new country, explore together, and strengthen our team. Here's a video from our latest retreat:



? Loved by the Team – Rated 5 out of 5 stars on Glassdoor:





???????? The Skinnify Story

Our founder Christian grew up in Frankfurt, Germany. Looking around, he noticed something striking: so many of the women in his life — his mom, his sister, his friends — wanted to get fitter, lose weight, and build muscle, but kept running into the same wall. They didn't have the time, the motivation, or the consistency to make the gym work.



The idea hit him during his own workout. He was using resistance bands and thought: what if these were built into everyday clothing? What if women could get the benefits of resistance training passively — while walking the kids to school, cooking dinner, or sitting at their desk? Fitness without the extra time or effort.



The idea was personal too. Christian was a difficult kid growing up and put his mom through a lot. She barely had time for herself, let alone the gym. He built Skinnify for women like her: busy, hardworking, often overlooked — so they could do something good for their bodies just by getting dressed.



????? Our Products

What started with a single product — leggings with built-in resistance bands — has grown into a full collection of resistance-integrated clothing: leggings, sleeves, shoes, and more. We're on a mission to revolutionize how women do fitness by turning daily life into a workout.



???? Skinnify's Core Values

???? Innovation – We design groundbreaking clothing with built-in resistance to revolutionize fitness.

???? Effectiveness – Our products help people burn more calories and get fitter with every step.

???? Accessibility – We make fitness accessible to everyone, even the busiest and least motivated.

???? Fun – We make exercise feel effortless and enjoyable.

? Quality – Our products are built to last—high-quality, durable, and reliable.



Ready to become the right hand behind a fast-growing global e-commerce brand? Apply now—we'd love to meet you!

title: Executive Assistant to CEO
description:
Position Overview:



As the Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth and efficient functioning of the executive office. Your primary responsibility will be to provide comprehensive administrative support to the CEO, managing their schedule, and coordinating various tasks to enhance productivity. Your ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and proactively handle administrative duties will contribute to the overall effectiveness of the CEO's office.

Our vision is to successfully wire 28,000 homes to completion by the year 2029, ensuring safe and efficient electrical solutions, thereby making a positive impact on the lives of our customers and communities. • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with individuals at all levels.

• Proactive problem solver and resourceful thinker.

THE ROLE IN ONE PARAGRAPH



You are an appointment setter. You record short Loom-style video pitches, send them privately to a lead list we provide, work the replies, handle objections, and book qualified appointments. You watch what gets responses and keep sharpening the pitch. The recordings you make and the pitch you refine then power the automated outbound system we build next.



We provide the script, the instructions, the lead list, the tools, and the coaching. You provide the voice, the face, and the follow-through.





WHO THIS JOB IS FOR



We are casting a wide net on background and a narrow one on ability. This role fits you if you are any of the following:



- An appointment setter or SDR who has booked meetings from cold outreach before

- A cold
 specialist or lead generation VA who knows how to work a list and a sequence

- An outbound or inside sales rep looking for flexible part-time hours

- A BDR who wants to test a video-first channel instead of the same old
 sequence

- A telemarketer or cold caller who is comfortable talking to strangers and hearing no

- A virtual assistant with sales experience who wants performance upside, not just hourly work

- An on-camera presenter, spokesperson, video creator, or UGC creator with no sales background at all



That last one is not a typo. If you have never sold anything but you come across confidently on camera, this role is for you. We provide the script and the instructions. Sales technique can be taught in a week. Being watchable on camera cannot.



If you can talk to a camera the way you talk to a friend, keep reading.





RESPONSIBILITIES



Video:



- Record short, natural video pitches (60 to 90 seconds) introducing ProxyLLM to prospects

- Work from the script and direction we provide while sounding like a person, not a reader

- Record variations on request: different hooks, different lengths, different calls to action

- Re-record when the messaging or the audio needs a fix

- Maintain consistent quality: clear audio, decent lighting, clean framing



Outreach and appointment setting:



- Send cold
 and video outreach to a lead list we provide

- Personalize outreach at the level the campaign calls for

- Work inbound replies quickly, ideally within the hour during your working block

- Handle objections and qualify prospects before booking

- Book qualified appointments on the founder's calendar, or drive prospects to an activated trial, depending on the campaign goal

- Follow up systematically. Most conversions live in the follow-up, not the first touch

- Keep your own pipeline moving without being chased



Testing and reporting:



- Test messaging, structure, subject lines, and calls to action

- Document what works and what does not

- Log every touch, reply, and conversion accurately in our CRM

- Report to the founder on objections you hear, pitch versions that land, and patterns you notice

- Join a short regular check-in





WHAT YOU NEED



- Fluent, natural spoken and written English

- Comfort on camera. You sound like a person talking, never like a script being read

- Organized and self-directed. You plan your own day and manage your own pipeline

- A reliable computer, a webcam or phone camera, and stable internet

- Experience with cold outreach, appointment setting, SDR work, lead generation, or on-camera presenting. Any one of these is enough





PAY



- $4 USD per hour for outreach hours

- Plus a performance bonus for every qualified conversion. A qualified conversion is an attended booked call or an activated trial signup

- Bonus amounts and the active conversion goal are set in the contractor agreement and may shift as we learn which pitch performs best

- Paid on a regular invoicing schedule





APPLY HERE: 



Applications close Saturday, July 18.





A 60-DAY CONTRACT, AND WE MEAN 60 DAYS



This is a temporary position. The contract runs 60 days and covers one specific project: piloting this outreach channel and producing the recordings that power its automated successor. You work as an independent contractor at about four hours a day on a schedule you set yourself.



When the 60 days end, the contract ends. Strong results may earn an extension offer, but apply expecting exactly 60 days. We would rather tell you this now than have it be a surprise later.





YOUR VIDEO AND YOUR LIKENESS



Read this section before you apply.



The recordings you make in this role are the product. They are sent privately to prospective customers as part of our outreach. We also generate AI variations from them and use of these materials continues after the contract ends.



All of this is a condition of the role. The contractor agreement spells it out in detail, and you can review it in full before you accept anything. Apply only if you are comfortable with every part of this.



HUMANS ONLY



We build AI tools, and the outreach system this project feeds will be automated. It still needs a real person at its core: your face and your voice. So the role is for a human, and the application must come from one. Record your video yourself and speak in your own words.





HOW TO APPLY



Apply through the application form. It walks you through everything, including what to cover in your video.



Have these ready:



- A short note on any outreach, sales, or on-camera experience you have. "None yet" is an acceptable answer if you can carry the camera.

- A video of you speaking on camera. Two minutes is plenty. Record it on your phone, or use 
 free, which is the same tool you will use on the job. No editing, no production, no script reading.

- A shareable link to that video, from Loom or Google Drive, with sharing set to public ("anyone with the link can view"). Open the link in a private browser window first to confirm it actually plays.



We review every application that arrives with a working video link. Applications without one get no reply.



One clarification: the likeness terms above cover recordings you make on the job. Your application video is just an application. We use it only to evaluate you, and you can ask us to delete it at any time.





APPLICATIONS CLOSE SATURDAY, JULY 18



We hire as we go. If you are a fit, do not wait for the deadline.



APPLY NOW: 



If this role is not for you but you know a reliable appointment setter, SDR, sales VA, or someone who is great on camera, we would appreciate the introduction.

title: UX/UI Designer & Front end - No graveyard shift
description:
About the project

We're an early-stage startup (still in stealth) building a booking marketplace for children's activities — think ClassPass, but for kids. Parents come to us to discover, book, and manage classes across providers in one place: sports, music, arts, coding, swimming, weekend enrichment, all of it. Right now the product experience is the thing that will d
 whether this works. 



So design isn't a coat of paint here — it's the core of what we're building.

We're looking for a designer to lead the UX and UI for our web platform — the discovery experience, the booking flow, and the parent's account — and take it from research through to polished, developer-ready screens. This is a defined project with a scope and a timeline, so we want someone who can own design end to end rather than just push pixels on someone else's plan.



Why this one's interesting



You're designing for two people at once — a busy parent making a decision, and a kid the product is ultimately for. Getting that balance right (trustworthy for adults, warm and playful without being childish) is the whole challenge.

It's a real marketplace problem: search, filters, availability, scheduling, checkout. Plenty of meaty UX to sink your teeth into.

Early stage means your work ships and your decisions stick. You'll help set the visual and interaction foundations the product grows on.



What you'll own

The heart of this role is UX and UI craft. Concretely, across the project you'll handle:

UX — research & structure

Map the core journeys — a parent discovering activities, comparing options, and booking — and pin down where they get stuck.

Turn that into information architecture, user flows, and wireframes we can pressure-test before we build.

Run lightweight usability checks on your own designs and fold what you learn back in.

UI — visual design & system

Design the interface: a clean, child-friendly, trustworthy look that parents take seriously and kids find inviting.

Build a reusable component library and design system so the product stays consistent as it grows.

Own the details — type, spacing, colour, states, empty screens, error handling. The stuff that separates "fine" from "feels good".



Prototyping & handoff

Build interactive Figma prototypes so we can feel a flow before committing to it.

Prepare developer-ready specs — tokens, redlines, states — and work closely with engineering through build. Comfort with how your designs translate to front-end code is a real plus.



Portfolio (required — please read)

A portfolio is non-negotiable. We won't be able to consider applications without one, so please don't apply without a link. We're far more interested in seeing the work than reading a CV.

What we're hoping to see:

Two or three projects where you clearly owned both the UX and the UI — not just one screen from a big team effort.

Your thinking, not just the final art: the problem, a few key decisions, and why you made them.

Examples across the surfaces we care about — ideally a responsive web experience, a mobile app, and a data-rich dashboard or admin panel. Real interaction complexity (booking flows, marketplaces) is a big plus.

Bonus if you can point to work for kids, parents, or education — but strong general product work beats a weak themed piece.



What we're looking for

Proven across all three surfaces: web, mobile app, and dashboard / admin interfaces. We want to see real, shipped work in each — this product spans all three.

A track record of taking UX and UI from start to finish, not just polishing someone else's screens.

Real fluency in Figma, from wireframes to a maintained component library and prototypes.

Solid instincts for interaction design, layout, typography, and colour — and the discipline to keep things consistent.

You can research a problem, defend a design decision, and take feedback without getting precious about it.

Hands-on with Claude Code: you can use it to turn your own designs into working front-end, so prototyping and handoff move fast. This one matters to us.

Self-directed. This is contract and remote, so you can run your own process and hit milestones without hand-holding.

Prefer availability 9 am to 6 pm (Phillipines time)



Nice to have

Experience designing for children, families, or education products.

A feel for motion / micro-interactions and how a bit of delight can help a kids product.

Accessibility know-how (WCAG) — this is a product families rely on.

Broader comfort with front-end (HTML/CSS) or other AI build tools beyond Claude Code.

The engagement



Type: Freelance / independent contract. Project-based.

Location: Fully remote. We work on Singapore time (UTC+8), so if you're in the Philippines your day lines up with ours — same hours, no graveyard shifts.



Pay: In PHP, paid reliably on agreed milestones via Wise or PayPal. No chasing, no surprises.

Scope: A defined project with milestones — research and flows, then UI and design system, then prototypes and handoff.

Rate: Competitive and open — tell us your rate (hourly or per-milestone) and roughly how you'd want to structure it.

Start: Soon. We're ready to move once we find the right person.



What's in it for you

A clearly scoped project with a real budget — you'll know what's expected and get paid on time, in PHP,  for hitting it.

Your hours, not ours-in-the-middle-of-your-night. Being in the same timezone means normal working days and easy live collaboration.

Ownership. This isn't ticket-work — you'll shape the product's UX and visual direction and see your designs actually ship.

If it clicks on both sides, there's real scope for more work beyond this first project as we grow.

A small, respectful, English-speaking team that values good design and won't micro-manage you.



How to apply

Send us four things — keep it short:

A link to your portfolio (required).

A couple of lines on a kids or booking-style product you'd redesign, and the first thing you'd change.

Your rate and availability.

Anything you want us to look at first.

No long cover letter needed. Show us the work and how you think, and we'll take it from there.

We're currently in stealth, so we'll share the company details and full brief once we're talking. We review every portfolio that comes in.

title: Systems Integrator (Business Systems)
description:
What this role is



You will configure and enforce rules inside existing business systems so that workflows cannot proceed unless required conditions are met.



This is not a strategy role.

This is not consulting.

This is not design or architecture.



This is hands-on execution inside real software.



?



What you’ll actually do

 • Work inside existing tools (CRM, billing, ops platforms, internal systems)

 • Configure constraints, gates, and required steps

 • Make workflows stop until required actions or records exist

 • Use native settings, permissions, automations, and integrations

 • Verify enforcement using system logs and records

 • Hand back a system that behaves predictably and cannot be bypassed



You are given clear instructions on what must be true.

Your job is to make the system behave that way.



?



Examples of systems you may touch



(You do not need to know all of these — familiarity with similar systems is enough.)

 • CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, etc.)

 • Billing & payments (Stripe, Chargebee, NetSuite, QuickBooks, etc.)

 • Internal tools (Airtable, Retool, Smartsheet, Notion, etc.)

 • Automation platforms (Zapier, Make, Workato, native automations)

 • Admin panels, permissions, and workflow settings



?



This role is a fit if

 • You’ve enforced workflows or controls inside software before

 • You’re comfortable entering unfamiliar systems and figuring them out

 • You understand how permissions, logs, and automation actually work

 • You don’t need hand-holding or creative freedom

 • You prefer clear requirements over vague goals

 • You have no interest in selling, presenting, or “consulting”



?



This role is NOT a fit if

 • You need to design solutions from scratch

 • You prefer strategy, ideation, or discovery calls

 • You dislike working inside admin panels and settings

 • You want to “improve” instructions instead of executing them

 • You need long explanations or detailed SOPs



?



Engagement structure

 • Project-based work

 • Clear start and end

 • Defined scope

 • No ongoing support unless explicitly requested

 • Paid per engagement



?



How to apply



In your application, briefly answer:

 1. What systems have you enforced rules or workflows in?

 2. Have you ever prevented a process from continuing until a condition was met? (Yes/No — brief context if yes)

 3. Are you comfortable working inside unfamiliar systems without step-by-step instructions? (Yes/No)



No long cover letters needed.



?



Important



This role exists to make systems behave correctly — not to explain why they should.



If that sounds obvious to you, you’re likely a fit.

title: Financial Manager (CPA) — Ecommerce, Remote Full-Time
description:
We're a fully remote performance-menswear brand selling mostly to US customers. We're small, fast, and run on a modern stack (Shopify, Airwallex, Xero, QuickBooks, Monday, Notion, Slack). We're hiring our first dedicated Financial Manager to take over and own everything finance. This is a long-term, full-time role reporting directly to the CEO, with real room to grow into the finance lead for the whole group.



A few things upfront: we pay reliably and on time, every time. We treat this as a serious, permanent seat - not a gig - and we want someone who plans to stay and grow with us for years.



Right now our finances are split between the CEO, our Chief of Staff, our procurement lead, and two outside accounting firms. Your job is to pull all of it under one owner. You won't do the raw bookkeeping - we keep external firms (in Hong Kong and Singapore) for the books, financial statements, audit and tax filing. You manage them, check their work, and turn their reports into decisions. You are the one person accountable for money moving correctly and the books being right.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Manage our outside accountants and keep every statutory deadline (audits, tax returns, filings) on track across our Hong Kong and Singapore entities.

- Run all payments and banking: check every invoice, prepare the weekly payment runs, and be the control point before the CEO approves.

- Take over supplier/procurement finance from our lead: purchasing report, supplier deposits and balance payments, FX handling, export-VAT verification, and keeping product costs (COGS) accurate in Shopify.

- Verify and reconcile all shipping and 3PL invoices (freight, warehousing, returns), catch overcharges, and pursue claims.

- Deliver a real monthly financial review - analyze the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow, don't just relay what the accountants send.

- Drive open compliance items to closure (e.g. US sales-tax registration).



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR (FORMAL TRAINING AND REAL SKILL - BOTH MATTER)

- A CPA and a degree in Accounting or Finance. This is a requirement - we want someone who has clearly been through accounting school and knows the discipline properly.

- Advanced in Excel - pivot tables, INDEX/MATCH or XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, and ideally Power Query. This is non-negotiable; you'll live in spreadsheets.

- Strong in core finance and accounting - the full cycle: AP/AR, bank and payment reconciliation, month-end close, management reporting, budgeting, cash flow. You understand WHY the numbers move, not just how to enter them.

- Hands-on with QuickBooks and/or Xero at a real working level, plus a payment platform (Airwallex or similar).

- Solid on compliance - you've personally been responsible for a tax, audit, or statutory filing and got it done correctly and on time.

- Detail-obsessed - you catch the wrong number, the wrong entity, the overcharge, the missed deadline.

- Excellent written and spoken English, self-directed, and comfortable working async in a remote team.

- Proven experience owning finance for a company (ecommerce/DTC, trading, or multi-entity a big plus).

- Total discretion and integrity - this role sees all company money.



DETAILS

- Full-time, long-term, and exclusive to us - 40 hours/week, no other clients. This role has full access to company banking, so we need your full focus and trust.

- Fully remote; must overlap our core hours (roughly 9am-6pm Philippine time).

- Salary USD 1,500-2,000/month based on experience, with a 90-day trial period, then a permanent long-term engagement.



HOW TO APPLY (PLEASE READ CAREFULLY - WE FILTER HARD FOR THIS)

We don't test skills on paper - anyone can type a perfect answer with AI now. We test them live. Here's what to send:

1. Start your application with the word "RECONCILED" so we know you read the full post.

2. Tell us about one finance function you've owned end to end and exactly what you were accountable for.

3. Record a 2-3 minute intro video / Loom - introduce yourself in English, tell us why this role fits you, and briefly describe the most advanced spreadsheet or financial model you've built (describe it in your own words - please don't share any confidential data or files from a current or past employer). Keep it unscripted; we want to hear how you think.

4. Include: your CPA license number (PRC registration) and where you studied accounting; your DISC and IQ scores (from your OnlineJobs.ph profile); your CV; your OnlineJobs.ph ID-verification status; and your earliest start date.



Applications that skip the intro video or the items above won't be reviewed.



HOW WE ASSESS SKILL: shortlisted candidates do a short live working session with us over video - the same set of real Excel and finance tasks for everyone, worked in real time with your screen shared, scored consistently. Come ready to actually build. We verify CPA licenses and check references before finalizing, given this role's access to company banking. We reply to every serious applicant.
